settings.headline: Built for performance operators.
settings.intro: Whether you're running paid traffic, managing affiliates, or reconciling ecommerce revenue, TraceKit helps connect the evidence behind your numbers.
settings.note: Capabilities and integration coverage depend on your connected systems.

settings.heading: Advertisers
settings.body: Understand acquisition performance alongside purchases, refunds, disputes, and costs.

settings.heading: Affiliate teams
settings.body: Trace clicks, conversions, source identifiers, and downstream commerce events.

settings.heading: Ecommerce operators
settings.body: Follow customers across orders, upsells, and financial adjustments.

settings.heading: Finance and operations
settings.body: Investigate reconciliation gaps with source-level evidence and clear exceptions.
